mapper.sql: consent_id, interaction_id, customer_id, consent_type, status, granted_by, granted_role, granted_at, withdrawal_reason, expires_at, legal_basis
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_consent ( consent_id, interaction_id, customer_id, consent_type, status, granted_by, granted_role, granted_at, withdrawal_reason, expires_at, legal_basis ) VALUES ( #{consentId}, #{interactionId}, #{customerId}, #{consentType}, #{status}, #{grantedBy}, #{grantedRole}, #{grantedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{withdrawalReason}, #{expiresAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{legalBasis} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM recording_consent WHERE interaction_id = #{interactionId} ORDER BY granted_at DESC
SELECT FROM recording_consent WHERE interaction_id = #{interactionId} ORDER BY granted_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM recording_consent WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY granted_at DESC
SELECT FROM recording_consent WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY granted_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_consent SET status = #{status}, withdrawal_reason = #{withdrawalReason} WHERE consent_id = #{consentId}
